( Case of Rex v. Indar Singh for Rape. )
S. B. REGISTRY.
6680
REMARKS OF REGISTRAR HAINES AS TO THE POWERS OF D. V. P.
FRENCH POLICE AND PUBLIC SAFETY BUREAU IN THE ARREST OF
BRITISH SUBJECTS.

At 2.30 p.m. April 17, 1935, the Registrar of H.B.M. Supreme Court
delivered the following instructions as to the powers of the S.M.P.
French Police and Public Safety Bureau in the arrest of British
Subjects:-

ARREST WITHOUT A WARRANT.

The Chinese Public Safety Bureau officers as well as
the Shanghai Municipal Police officers and the French
Municipal Police officers are not Police officers with-
in the meaning of English Law, although for the sake of
good government they act as such.
When these officers are dealing with British Subjects
they must be careful to conform to the English Law of
Arrest. There are two forms (1) By Warrant (2) Without
Warrant. For the sake of clearness I will recite their
powers :-

(1) BY WARRANT. This means a warrant issued by this
Court. In the case of mis-demeanours as distinct from
felonies an arrest cannot be made without a warrant.

(2) WITHOUT A WARRANT. A police officer may arrest with-
out a warrant for a breach of the peace in his presence.
He as well as a private person is bound to arrest a person
if a felony or a dangerous wound is committed in his
presence. Where a felony has been committed and there is
reasonable suspicion of his having committed it.
In this case there was not even a reasonable suspicion of
the accused committing a felony when he was arrested. For
the charge now preferred, being a mis-demeanour a warrant
should have first been obtained.

海恩斯登记官关于上海公共租界工部局警务处、
法国警察及公共安全处在逮捕英国臣民方面之权限的备注。

1935年4月17日下午2时30分，英王陛下最高法院登记官就上海公共租界工部局警务处、
法国市政警察及公共安全处在逮捕英国臣民方面的权限，作出如下指示：-

无令状逮捕。

中国公共安全处警官、上海公共租界工部局警务处警官以及
法国市政警察警官，虽为良好治理之故行使警察职权，
但依英国法律之义，他们并非警察官员。
当这些警官处理涉及英国臣民的案件时，必须注意遵守
英国的逮捕法。逮捕有两种形式：(1) 凭令状；(2) 无令状。
为清晰起见，兹列举其权限如下：-

(1) 凭令状。此指由本法院签发的令状。在轻罪（区别于重罪）案件中，
若无令状，不得实施逮捕。

(2) 无令状。警察官员可在其目睹破坏和平行为时，
无令状实施逮捕。若在其面前发生重罪或造成危险伤害，
该警官以及任何私人均有义务逮捕行为人。
若已发生重罪，且有合理理由怀疑某人实施了该重罪，亦可逮捕。
在本案中，被告被捕时，甚至不存在其犯有重罪的合理怀疑。
鉴于目前提出的指控属于轻罪，本应先取得令状。

This Court has no wish to embarrass the Chinese Police
but on the contrary is anxious to give them every
assistance but where British Subjects are concerned
the formalities of British Law must be complied with.
I consider that this man was most improperly arrested
by the Chinese Police, no doubt through ignorance of
our procedure and I have felt bound to pass these
remarks.
I will conclude by saying that this Court is always
ready to assist the Chinese Police, and will always be
ready to issue warrants for the arrest of British
Subjects when there are sufficient grounds to justify it.
(signed) C. H. Haines.
17/4/35.
pages.zh:
( 2 )

本法院无意使中国警方感到为难，相反，亟愿给予其一切协助，
但在涉及英国臣民时，必须遵守英国法律的正式程序。
我认为此人被中国警方逮捕极不妥当，这无疑是由于他们
不熟悉我们的程序所致，故我觉得有必要发表上述意见。
最后我要说明，本法院随时准备协助中国警方，
在有充分理由证明正当的情况下，本法院将随时签发
逮捕英国臣民的令状。
（签名）C. H. 海恩斯。
1935年4月17日。
